details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7659 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The "Send Telegram notification" step requires E2E to equal "success", so a skip_e2e=true run that successfully releases is reported as "Release X FAILED" because E2E is "skipped".
  WHY: Reviewers rated this MAJOR, which is mapped to high. The validate gate and the supplemental-job loop already accept "skipped", and the misleading FAILED message can prompt an operator to re-run or roll back a release that shipped.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:6578-6583 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new explicit-result `release` job `if:` has no `!inputs.dry_run` term, so release now runs on dry_run=true and holds the shared stable-release concurrency group.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR and qwen rated it NIT, so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped the claim because the old gate `success() && !inputs.gate_only` had no dry_run term either, and every mutating step is separately gated on `!inputs.dry_run`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:6577-6582, 7341-7345 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `>-` block scalar continuation lines for the `if` conditions may be incorrectly indented, which would make the YAML invalid.
  WHY: Reviewers rated this BLOCKER, which is mapped to critical. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it as false because the continuation lines are indented 6 spaces, deeper than the 4-space `if:` key.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "test-and-mark-stable.yml with skip_e2e=true never tags a release" / the documented emergency path ('Skip E2E test and only mark stable') works again, including a correct release notification
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml "Send Telegram notification" step, SUCCEEDED predicate at line 7659 and release_ok derivation at lines 7655-7658
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The diff changes only the `release` and `sync-to-main` job `if:` conditions, and the notify step still gates on `needs.e2e-smoke-test.result == 'success'`, with no hunk accepting E2E="skipped".
- requirement: Preserve the documented behaviour that dry_run=true skips the release job
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml `release` job `if:` (lines 6578-6583)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk adds `!inputs.dry_run` to the new `release` `if:`, and the test in tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py does not cover dry_run handling or the notify step.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7613, 7659 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The notify step requires E2E to be exactly `success`, but with skip_e2e=true the result is `skipped`, even though the validate gate (line 6443) and the supplemental-job loop (line 7639) accept `skipped`.
  WHY: Now that `release` runs on the skip_e2e path, a successful release sends "Release X FAILED", which can prompt a re-run into the partial-release recovery paths.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Notify job (Telegram notification step) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Telegram notification step relies on the e2e-smoke-test job succeeding, so with skip_e2e=true it reports failure even when the release succeeds.
  WHY: The notification reports "Release vX.Y.Z FAILED", which can trigger unnecessary recovery actions.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:6577-6582 and 7341-7345 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `>-` block scalar continuation lines for the `if` conditions must be properly indented relative to the `if` key, and consensus findings suggest they may not be.
  WHY: Invalid YAML indentation would stop the workflow from parsing.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "test-and-mark-stable.yml with skip_e2e=true never tags a release." (Fixing the notify job so it does not report failure when e2e tests are skipped.)
  Expected change site: Notify job (Telegram notification step)
  Evidence of absence: The PR description says the fix covers the `release` and `sync-to-main` jobs, but the Telegram notification job still gates on `needs.e2e-smoke-test.result == 'success'`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7659 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A successful skip_e2e=true release falls into the FAILED Telegram branch because the predicate requires E2E="success", while e2e-smoke-test is `skipped` (line 572).
  WHY: The Telegram summary says FAILED while STATUS_LINE shows `release: ✓ (success)`, and the contradiction can prompt an operator to retry or roll back a release that shipped.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:6578-6583 (with concurrency at 6616-6618, timeout-minutes 50 at 6588) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `release` gate omits `!inputs.dry_run`, so release now runs on dry_run=true and holds the `stable-release-${{ github.repository }}` concurrency group for up to 50 minutes.
  WHY: With cancel-in-progress false, a real-release dispatch queues behind the dry run, which the old gate avoided by skipping the job.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "the documented emergency path ('Skip E2E test and only mark stable') works again", meaning a skip_e2e=true dispatch should give a successful release and a successful release notification.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml around the SUCCEEDED predicate in the `Send Telegram notification` step (line 7659) and the release_ok derivation (lines 7655-7658). The new `release` job `if:` (line 6578) should also carry `!inputs.dry_run`.
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk updates the notify-step predicate to accept E2E="skipped" when the release succeeded, and none adds `!inputs.dry_run` to the new `release` `if:`. The test in tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py covers neither dry_run handling nor the notify step, and the changelog entry does not document the notify-step correction.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7659 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The notify success predicate still requires E2E=success, so under skip_e2e=true (E2E=skipped) it falls into the FAILED branch even though release succeeds and the tag is pushed.
  WHY: A skip_e2e=true dispatch tags the release and syncs to main, then sends "Release vX.Y.Z FAILED". The existing release_ok pattern (line 7656) already accepts `skipped` for supplemental jobs.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:6578-6583 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new release gate has no `!inputs.dry_run` term, so release executes on dry_run=true and holds the `stable-release-<repo>` concurrency group (lines 6616-6618) for up to 50 minutes.
  WHY: A dry run can queue behind or block a real release, though this may be deliberate because the previous `success() && !inputs.gate_only` gate also let dry runs enter `release`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
